snippet.title: Sibling Souls - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3383360/Sibling_Souls/

Year 2147: In a city where androids and vampires rule, you're caught in the crossfire. Searching for your lost twin, who will you trust—and what are you willing to sacrifice? Every choice shapes your fate—for better or worse—in this dark visual novel.

Trailer Music: Esoteric Execution by Gioele Fazzeri (Pixabay)
https://pixabay.com/es/music/misterio-esoteric-execution-epic-dark-and-horror-soundtrack-197591/
